deviations: Intent carries a required version_id field (7th field). The plan's field list omitted it, but task 1 requires the version id stamped on each Intent. StrategyContext also carries version_id so the hook can stamp it. Owner should confirm before the freeze is treated as final.

TickSnapshot and TapePoint field sets were not named by the plan. Chosen minimal set: TickSnapshot(mint, ts, launch_ts, price_lamports, unique_buyers, curve_progress); TapePoint(ts, price_lamports). Money is integer lamports. Frozen with this plan; owner should review.
version_id takes the strategy class and effective params: version_id(strategy_cls, params). The plan's shorthand version_id(params) cannot read the strategy id or module source without the class.
Intent rejects size_lamports <= 0 in addition to float and bool types; side is restricted to buy or sell.

legacy_screening is a stub class defined in registry.py (empty BOUNDS, on_tick returns an empty tuple) because the plan keeps the adapter for 15-03. 15-03 should move it to legacy.py and re-export it.

tests/strategies/test_registry.py does not assert baseline equality for momentum_breakout, new_launch_sniper or mean_reversion. It asserts the TOML sections not registered equal the deferred set exactly. 15-04 must delete DEFERRED_TO_15_04 and add per-strategy equality. No skip is used.

Test commands run as uv run python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider with output redirected, per the environment note that bare pytest -q reports a false No tests collected. Plan-form commands are equivalent and listed above.
The green run for task 2 re-included tests/strategies/test_base.py, so test_base ran twice in total (task 1 green and task 2 green).
paper-event.toml header comments were rewritten. Comments are not values; the test compares parsed TOML, so every non-risk value equals paper.toml exactly.
